# ship-device

Your interface to the `device` ops. Invoke each over ConnectRPC:

```
ship ops call <name> --json '<args-json>'
```

Reads are safe (C0). Commands carry a blast-radius class. Open an op's reference
page for full args, return shape, capability, and an example.

## Reads

- [`device.window_intent`](references/docs/device.window_intent.mdoc) — Focus-vs-spawn decision for opening a window (the shell adaptor executes it).
- [`device.window_list`](references/docs/device.window_list.mdoc) — Enumerate window actors the daemon knows about (actor id, space, pid, live).

## Commands

- [`device.close_window`](references/docs/device.close_window.mdoc) `[C3_CRITICAL]` — Revoke a window's pid-bound token and close its lifecycle (operator-only).
- [`device.register_window`](references/docs/device.register_window.mdoc) `[C3_CRITICAL]` — Register a launched window and mint its pid-bound, C2-capped session (operator-only; pid is kernel-attested).
